brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Four full bases: piece:-1,0,0 and piece:0,0,0 make the left pair; piece:1,0,0 and piece:2,0,0 make the right pair.

requirements.requirement: Each pair's two bases are joined to each other as a pair
requirements.evidence: jointBolt:0#-1,0#0 joins the bases at -1,0 and 0,0. jointBolt:0#1,0#0 joins the bases at 1,0 and 2,0.

requirements.requirement: The two pairs are joined to each other with side connectors
requirements.evidence: One double side connector (connector:0#0,0|1,0) sits on the wall between the pairs. The configurator offered only one connector spot on that wall.

requirements.requirement: The pairs are joined to each other only by the side connectors (no joint bolts between the pairs)
requirements.evidence: The wall between 0,0 and 1,0 has only the connector, with no joint bolt or cap. I left out lockJoints for this reason.

finish.summary:
I built four full bases in a straight row as two separate pairs. The left pair is (-1,0) and (0,0); the right pair is (1,0) and (2,0). The bases in each pair are fastened together with a joint bolt. The only thing joining the two pairs is one double side connector on the wall between (0,0) and (1,0). The configurator offered just one connector spot on that wall.

I capped all the open outer faces with solid end caps. I did not run lockJoints on purpose: it would have put a joint bolt on the wall between the pairs too, so they would no longer be joined only by the side connector.

check_build reports no issues and the mesh-collision check is clear. The build has 25 parts: 4 bases, 2 joint bolts, 1 side connector and 18 caps.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
